trials.claim: Unlimited live streams can be added to each event including YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, or custom RTMP/HLS
trials.claimQuote: Add unlimited live streams to each event. Add YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, or your custom RTMP/HLS
trials.reasoning: The reviews only mention multi-track or multiple live streams, not unlimited streams per event or support for YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, and custom RTMP/HLS.

exhibits.quote: offering a robust suite of features like customizable branding, multi-track live streams, exhibitor booths, and interactive lounges for networking.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms platform offers multi-track live streams as part of its event features, supporting unlimited live streams claim.

exhibits.quote: The platform provides a seamless user experience with advanced features like multiple live streams 🎥, interactive lounges 🤝, and customizable exhibitor pages 🎭.
exhibits.argument: Buyer review confirms multiple live streams are available, corroborating the unlimited live streams capability.

trials.claim: Easy AWS integration to add video calls between attendees
trials.claimQuote: Easy integration with AWS to add video calls between attendees
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly says the AWS integration is easy and worked pretty well, and another confirms AWS integration exists; a mention of a learning curve with tutorials does not materially contradict that.

exhibits.quote: Also, there's the whole AWS consideration. I suggest reading up on that aspect of the platform.
exhibits.argument: Quote warns buyers that AWS integration has extra considerations to research, undermining the claim it is easy.

exhibits.quote: The integration with AWS is easy and worked pretty well. There is a bit of a learning curve, but there are tutorials that help.
exhibits.argument: Quote admits AWS integration requires a learning curve and tutorials, contradicting the claim it is easy.

exhibits.quote: The integration with AWS is easy and worked pretty well.
exhibits.argument: Buyer directly confirms AWS integration is easy, matching the seller's easy AWS integration claim.

exhibits.quote: With its flexibility, cost-effective AWS integration, and standout customer service, BeHuman.Online is definitely worth checking out
exhibits.argument: Review confirms cost-effective AWS integration exists, supporting the AWS integration claim.

trials.claim: Can generate access codes to delegate access or import to ticketing service for distribution
trials.claimQuote: Generate access codes - delegate access or import to ticketing service for distribution
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were provided about generating access codes or importing them to a ticketing service.

trials.claim: One CNAME link / custom domain link is included
trials.claimQuote: One CNAME link / custom domain link included
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm custom domain setup was provided with DNS instructions and that events can be hosted on a custom domain, with no exhibit contradicting inclusion.

exhibits.quote: I requested a custom domain setup and received clear DNS instructions within hours.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms custom domain setup is provided via support, supporting included CNAME/custom domain link.

exhibits.quote: even hosting events on a custom domain. With its flexibility, cost-effective AWS integration, and standout customer service, BeHuman.Online is definitely worth
exhibits.argument: Review confirms ability to host events on a custom domain, supporting the included custom domain link claim.

trials.claim: BeHuman.Online is a virtual conference/expo/coaching/meet-up platform that engages attendees
trials.claimQuote: Virtual conference / expo / coaching / meet-up platform that engages attendees
trials.reasoning: The vendor page and a buyer review describe it as a platform for professional/coaching events and virtual/hybrid events with high engagement; the vague refund comment does not directly contradict that description.

exhibits.quote: The platform generally looks great, but unfortunately, I came across a few limitations that means I will be requesting a refund after writing this review.
exhibits.argument: Quote reports limitations severe enough to request a refund, undermining the claim the platform engages attendees.

exhibits.quote: Professional events, associations, coaching groups, foster a friendly and collaborative environment. High engagement, at low cost.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own page describes platform for professional events and coaching groups with high engagement, matching the virtual conference/expo/coaching platform claim.

exhibits.quote: BeHuman.Online is a powerful platform for running virtual and hybrid events, offering a robust suite of features like customizable branding, multi-track live streams
exhibits.argument: Buyer review confirms it is a powerful platform for running virtual and hybrid events, supporting the platform type claim.
